tasks.AdditionalPensionCalculation: Calculate the additional pension based on the 5% entitlement starting after 20 years.
tasks.InitialPensionCalculation: Calculate the initial annual pension for Marcy after working for 40 years.
tasks.TotalAnnualPensionCalculation: Sum up the initial and additional pensions to find the total annual pension if Marcy quits after 30 years.
